title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: I’m just waiting for the best time. Don’t think this is it
Lol that’s pretty damn funny though
I’ll prob do it to one of your tweets tomorrow
Might even turn the notifications on so I can be quick to it so it’s the first reply
I’ve got a couple ideas to bury you in response and I guarantee almost all of them would get approval from PR
I wouldn’t try to bury me in response to “announce Puig”
I think that would be a miscalculation on the part of the Detroit Tigers twitter feed
I hear you, but in my professional opinion I would want to take advantage of the moment when there’s a lot of eyeballs
I’m sure whatever your thinking has something to do with me not being there. That would be viewed as bush league and also adds fuel to the fire that the Tigers are thin-skinned, IMO
“Thanks for your input, Anthony. We noticed the Detroit News is down here. Will the Freep be joining?”
And it wouldn’t be a shot at you, because I’m not trying to be a dick like that.
I know, I know. I’m just a little sensitive still
If I wanted to do that I’d say “Will you be in Cleveland when the Atlanta Hawks are in town?”
Because you were covering the Cavs yesterday. That one isn’t as good now that I reread it.”
